data.narrative:
AGent Energy is a Seed-stage climate and energy company that has raised $6M to date. The comparable universe in Climate & Energy spans one public company (LNZA) and eight private peers including Redwood Materials, QuantumScape, and KoBold Metals, though narrow peer matching proved constrained.

Only one valuation method was applicable to this analysis. The Stage-Progression approach uses $6M in total raised as a valuation proxy and applies a 2.5x step-up multiplier typical for Seed-to-next-stage advancement, yielding $15M. A Peer-Median approach was not viable because the Climate & Energy peer set, while containing eight companies, yielded fewer than three datapoints when filtered for same-stage, adjacent-stage, or similar-valuation-tier comparables. Relying on an all-sector median would lack appropriate specificity.

The triangulated valuation range is $13M (low), $15M (median), to $17M (high), derived from a single methodological input with ±15% sensitivity bounds. This narrow range reflects dependence on stage-progression mechanics rather than market-derived multiples. Key uncertainties include whether the $6M raised proxy accurately reflects AGent Energy's effective post-money valuation at Seed close, and whether Seed-stage step-up multipliers in climate tech have shifted meaningfully given recent sector capital dynamics. Additional comparable data from same-stage climate companies would improve confidence in this estimate.
